summary: SettingsManager owns private structural contexts keyed by the five SettingsParameters selectors. It captures selected source state once, materializes every complete invocation as a fresh owned result, and exposes direct get_or_create/get-existing/status routes without a public result map.
lifecycle_notes: Context initialization captures source inputs outside broad manager locks and publishes only complete capture
get_or_create_settings and get_settings_object accept keyword-only reinitialise operation control
Standard BaseSettings inherited constructors remain cached-compatible; plain custom constructors fail before source reads
risks: Contexts deliberately pin selected source inputs until separate lifecycle work introduces an approved refresh contract
